# IT System Security and Performance Review

This document details essential tasks for maintaining and improving the bank's IT infrastructure.

## Firewall Settings Management

*   Review firewall settings based on audit findings.
*   Update firewall settings quarterly.

## API Latency Monitoring and Optimization

*   Monitor API latency for standard updates.
*   Optimize API latency based on audit recommendations.
*   Monitor API latency urgently.
